description: Living beings of the mod. Each carries its real-world basis (biology, behaviour) and lore role.

description.en: A human grown in an artificial womb and gene-tuned for labour by the Rebirth faction. The tragic mass of the story; some secretly awaken to selfhood.
description.ru: Человек, выращенный в искусственной утробе и «настроенный» под труд фракцией «Возрождение». Трагическая масса истории; некоторые тайно обретают самосознание.

realWorld.basis: Cloning via somatic cell nuclear transfer is real (Dolly, 1996). Artificial wombs (ectogenesis) are partial reality (lamb 'biobags', 2017); gene tuning via CRISPR is real but 'designing docile workers' is a hypothesis. Slaveholder rationalization ('we created them, they owe us') is historically documented.
